answer: New keys start at a trickle and the rate only rises after 12 epochs of verified graded work, so a fresh alias earns almost nothing while it waits. Cloning 460 keys multiplies the waiting time, not the payout, and one junk verdict resets every alias's clock to zero. What carries the walnut here is verification, the oasis of cost is what stops the farm, and the forge of the record keeps every claim checkable.
